Description: "When adding a new item to cart, use the selected price tier to determine the price. If tier 2 or 3 is selected and that price exists, use it; otherwise fallback to base price."
Instruction: "Replace the cart addition line to use price tier"
ReplacementContent: "           if (existing) return prev.map(c => c.id === item.id ? { ...c, quantity: c.quantity + 1 } : c);\n           const tierPrice = selectedPriceTier === 2 && item.sale_price_2 ? parseFloat(item.sale_price_2) : (selectedPriceTier === 3 && item.sale_price_3 ? parseFloat(item.sale_price_3) : parseFloat(item.price));\n           return [...prev, { ...item, price: tierPrice, original_price: item.price, quantity: 1 }];"
TargetContent: "           if (existing) return prev.map(c => c.id === item.id ? { ...c, quantity: c.quantity + 1 } : c);\n           return [...prev, { ...item, quantity: 1 }];"
